items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: I even remember Count Beardsy before he had his big band. Count used to play in a little club that used to be called a Grotto Club.

ctx.x: Oh really? Yeah, I know they had a band. Yeah. They made a record. That's right.
I even remember Count Beardsy before he had his big band. Count used to play in a little club that used to be called a Grotto Club.
Yeah, I've heard about those days in Kansas City. That's right.
